note: The one source for "Notably NOT free": scripts/build.mjs renders the README section (AUTOGEN:not-free) and the /not-free/ page from this file. Every quote is copied verbatim from docs/sources.md or data/quotes.json (quote_ids), with the same source URL and date; scripts/not-free.test.mjs checks that. `checked` is the UTC day the provider's page was read, or null when no date is recorded.

groups.title: No ongoing free API tier
groups.intro: API use is paid in advance with credits and stops when they run out. Their "Free" or "Tier 0" rows are rate-limit tiers, not free usage, and any recurring API credits are promotional or come with paid plans.

groups.title: A card or prepayment before any API use
groups.intro: Providers people *assume* are free, but which currently require a card or prepayment before any API use, per their own docs. Some have handed out small one-time trial credits at various points, but that has changed repeatedly; check each provider's billing page before assuming anything.

groups.title: Retired or removed after re-verification
groups.intro: Listed here before, removed (or moved) when a re-check of the provider's own pages no longer supported free access.

alternatives_note: For genuinely free access to strong models, your best bets here are **Gemini** (frontier-class) and the free open-weight models on **Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare and Z.ai** (SiliconFlow's free models are on its China platform and need real-name verification).

entries.name: OpenAI
entries.expectation: The rate-limits guide has a "Free" row, so the API looks free to start.
entries.summary: No ongoing free API tier is established. New API accounts pay in advance; requests fail once credits run out. The rate-limits guide's "Free" row is a usage tier (allowed geography, $100/month limit), not a statement that usage is free. Promotional credits exist, including for eligible ChatGPT subscriptions, but no recurring free allowance is published.
entries.short: prepaid billing; the "Free" row is a rate-limit tier
quotes: New API accounts use prepaid billing.
Prepaid billing lets you purchase credits before using the API.
When a prepaid account runs out of credits, API requests begin returning a billing error.

entries.name: Anthropic
entries.expectation: Claude has a consumer Free plan, so the API is assumed to have one too.
entries.summary: No ongoing free API tier. Credits are bought before use; recurring monthly API credits come only with the paid Max, Ultra and Team plans. The consumer Free plan is chat, not API.
entries.short: credits are bought before use; the Free plan is chat, not API
quotes: Buy credits before you use the API, and they're applied to your usage according to our current pricing.
If you run out of credits, you can no longer call the API or use the playground until you add more.

entries.name: xAI
entries.expectation: The rate-limit table starts at "Tier 0 / $0", which reads like a free tier.
entries.summary: No ongoing free API tier. "Tier 0 / $0" is a rate-limit tier based on cumulative spend, not a usage allowance; by default only prepaid credits are used.
entries.short: "Tier 0 / $0" is a rate-limit tier; prepaid credits only
quotes: Your API requests will be automatically rejected once your prepaid credits are depleted.

entries.name: Together AI
entries.expectation: It publishes free-tier rate limits, which look like free access.
entries.summary: The official billing article says there are no free trials and platform access requires a minimum $5 credit purchase. Rate limits do not establish whether access is free.
entries.short: no free trials; a minimum $5 credit purchase
quotes: Together AI does not currently offer free trials.
Access to the Together platform requires a minimum $5 credit purchase.
